'''Magma Sprites''' are an [[Monsters|enemy]] found in the [[Volcano Dungeon]]. 150 Magma monsters (either type) need to be killed for the [[Adventurer's Guild#Monster Eradication Goals|Monster Eradication Goal]] at the [[Adventurer's Guild]].

==Behavior==
Magma Sprites will fly through walls towards the player at high velocities, dealing damage on hit. They are very common, meaning that they, with their stronger counterparts [[Magma Sparker|Magma Sparkers]], can easily swarm a player who is not equipped with a strong enough weapon.
